method: Chosen before any measurement, from the formats the D7 gate of REQ-polaris-generation-046 2.6 removed (docs/evidence/syzygy-3efd-24/citable-share-v2-2026-11-22.json, zeroPathEntries) and the languages and configuration formats the bead and its lead name (Scala, Haskell, Elixir, Erlang, Dart, Julia, Kotlin, Swift, C and C++ with CMake, Terraform and HCL, protobuf, docs in MDX, AsciiDoc and reStructuredText). One or two widely used public GitHub repositories per format, each its language's or format's well-known project rather than a repository picked for a path count; no repository is replaced or dropped after measuring. Repositories are measured at their HEAD on the day, from tree metadata only. Not chosen: a Visual Basic repository (the one large candidate, dotnet/roslyn, is a C# compiler whose .vb files are test inputs), so .vb is measured only where it occurs by chance.
